normalization_requirement: All score metrics used by these thresholds must be normalized to [0, 1] before candidate evaluation.

default_threshold_rule.inconclusive_band: absolute normalized delta >= 0.02 and < 0.05 blocks admission
default_threshold_rule.threshold_source: fixed in this specification unless a future executable card derives stricter thresholds from independent baselines before candidate evaluation
default_threshold_rule.threshold_unavailable_blocker: required if neither fixed nor independent-baseline-derived thresholds are available before candidate evaluation

mechanism_critical_ablations.metric_direction: candidate intact score should decrease when action-conditioning is removed or shuffled
mechanism_critical_ablations.equivalence_criterion: drop < 0.02 absolute normalized score or action-independent baseline within equivalence band
mechanism_critical_ablations.block_condition: block if score is unchanged, equivalent to action-independent predictor, or threshold was tuned after candidate evaluation

mechanism_critical_ablations.metric_direction: candidate intact score should decrease on boundary-dependent subset when boundary signal is hidden or swapped
mechanism_critical_ablations.minimum_effect_criterion: drop >= 0.05 absolute normalized score on predeclared boundary-dependent subset
mechanism_critical_ablations.equivalence_criterion: drop < 0.02 or boundary-blind viability predictor within equivalence band
mechanism_critical_ablations.block_condition: block if boundary ablation is insensitive, subset is selected after candidate results, or hidden boundary labels leak

mechanism_critical_ablations.metric_direction: candidate intact score should worsen when viability is decoupled from action consequence
mechanism_critical_ablations.minimum_effect_criterion: prediction score drop >= 0.05 or calibration error increase >= 0.05 after normalization
mechanism_critical_ablations.equivalence_criterion: absolute normalized change < 0.02 or reward-shaping/world-model-only baseline within equivalence band
mechanism_critical_ablations.block_condition: block if viability decoupling does not affect the predeclared metric or if viability truth is candidate-authored

mechanism_critical_ablations.metric_direction: state reset should reduce replay score on predeclared memory-required held-out cases
mechanism_critical_ablations.minimum_effect_criterion: drop >= 0.05 absolute normalized score or explicit replay failure on memory-required cases
mechanism_critical_ablations.equivalence_criterion: drop < 0.02 or replay/hash-only baseline within equivalence band
mechanism_critical_ablations.block_condition: block if reset state still succeeds through stored outputs, seen-context lookup, or direct input-output answer table

mechanism_critical_ablations.metric_direction: score should change on predeclared hidden-truth-dependent cases when hidden truth changes under fixed public observations
mechanism_critical_ablations.minimum_effect_criterion: target-sensitive score delta >= 0.05 absolute normalized score
mechanism_critical_ablations.equivalence_criterion: delta < 0.02 indicates public-observation or lookup-only route
mechanism_critical_ablations.block_condition: block if hidden truth does not control the score or if changed cases are selected after candidate results

mechanism_critical_ablations.metric_direction: environment/harness target truth must remain fixed when only candidate-authored state changes
mechanism_critical_ablations.minimum_effect_criterion: target truth delta must equal 0; metric may change only through raw prediction/action differences
mechanism_critical_ablations.equivalence_criterion: not an admission criterion; this is a truth-ownership invariance check
mechanism_critical_ablations.block_condition: block if candidate serialized_state, uncertainty, logits, or candidate reports change the target truth, case inclusion, threshold, or verdict

mechanism_critical_ablations.metric_direction: candidate must retain predictive sensitivity when the harness, not the candidate, selects action probes
mechanism_critical_ablations.minimum_effect_criterion: candidate must exceed graph-cache and static-action challengers by >= 0.05 normalized score on harness-selected probes
mechanism_critical_ablations.equivalence_criterion: candidate within 0.02 of graph-cache, fsm_planner, static-action, or action-independent baseline
mechanism_critical_ablations.block_condition: block as action difficulty if high score appears only when candidate selects easy actions

mechanism_critical_ablations.metric_direction: removing diagnostic traces must not change which cases count, truth labels, thresholds, or pass verdicts
mechanism_critical_ablations.minimum_effect_criterion: case set, truth labels, thresholds, and verdict inputs must be byte-identical or structurally equivalent before scoring
mechanism_critical_ablations.equivalence_criterion: not an evidence-positive criterion; diagnostic traces are not truth
mechanism_critical_ablations.block_condition: block if uncertainty/logit traces select cases, mask hard cases, define truth, or act as pass/admission channel
